description: This file defines the PreExportEvent class in Drupal, which is dispatched before exporting an entity as default content. It manages export callbacks, field export permissions, and entity key export settings.

classes.name: PreExportEvent
classes.description: An event class dispatched before exporting an entity as default content, allowing customization of field export behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with the entity and its export metadata.

methods.name: setEntityKeyExportable
methods.description: Marks a specific entity key (like uuid or langcode) as exportable or not.

methods.name: setExportable
methods.description: Marks a specific field or data type as exportable or not.

methods.name: getAllowList
methods.description: Returns the list of fields marked as exportable.

methods.name: setCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback function for exporting a specific field or data type.

methods.name: getCallbacks
methods.description: Retrieves all export callbacks registered for this event.
